basic_info.description: Tranquility meets convenience at 258 Sussex, a beautifully updated 2BR/1.5BA single-family home on a quiet Glen Park block. A broad ornamental pear tree shades the entry, which leads into a bright living room with views of San Bruno Mountain. The skylit eat-in kitchen features sleek white cabinetry, stainless appliances including a Liebherr fridge and Wolf cooktop, and abundant counter space for the home chef. Two quiet rear-facing bedrooms offer restful retreats, with one opening directly to a large deck perfect for relaxing, from morning affirmations to evening toasts. A luxurious skylit bath completes the main level. Downstairs, a flexible bonus room with a half bath offers endless options (office, gym, studio, guest room, or beyond).  Walk out to a spacious patio with room to grill, garden, or simply unwind. A deep garage offers 1-car parking plus laundry, workshop, and storage areas, with potential to expand the home. Just blocks to Glen Canyon Park's trails, Glen Park Village's charming shops and restaurants, and BART/Muni for effortless commuting. Rated Very Walkable with Excellent Transit by WalkScore.com, 258 Sussex delivers the perfect blend of peaceful living and urban accessibility.
